verdict.rationale: Several items come from the public astral-sh/uv GitHub repository, which shows the project is hosted in a publicly accessible repo, and uv-docs-52 describes it as written in Rust. However, nothing in the pack states the license terms, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), first-party statement that the source is open, independent corroboration of the licensing.
